notes.title: Just released our first hentai game: HENTAI DOLLS
notes.content:
Get ready for Hentai Dolls!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45125792/632cb3b393bb7f72366498ff6f81adf5bf53e423.jpg

Our new futanari game is now live! featuring a growing roster of 9 characters, new redesigned anime-style hentai visuals, 5 unique scenes, and intro comics for every scenario.

Enjoy specialized voice acting, plus fun features you already know and love like like spanking, boob jiggle...
